title: Fork
description: A new execution lineage derived from an existing checkpoint. Records the provenance link from a fork back to its source, enabling full execution lineage reconstruction.

fork_id.description: Globally-unique identifier for this fork. Recommended format: fork-<source_checkpoint_id>-<nonce>.

source_checkpoint_id.description: checkpoint_id of the parent checkpoint this fork was created from.

fork_reason.description: Semantic reason for creating this fork.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this fork was created.

target_branch.description: Optional label identifying the execution branch or environment this fork targets.

parent_run_id.description: run_id of the execution that produced the source checkpoint, for lineage tracing.
